info.title: ZHIXU API
info.description: System health, Workspace, durable Workflow and M5 Change Control contracts. Apply preflight reads the real Workspace file hash but never writes files or creates Git commits.

200.description: The API process is responding.
Configuration and PostgreSQL are ready.
Current API and database status.

201.description: Workspace created with a real Git baseline.

400.description: Invalid path, name or Git choice.

409.description: Workspace root or active Workspace conflict.

503.description: Database, Git or Workspace service unavailable.

200.description: Persisted Workspace with refreshed Git status.

409.description: Persisted Workspace and Git state are inconsistent.

post.description: Safely discovers supported files, hashes them and registers immutable Source/SourceVersion metadata without modifying user files. It does not claim parse or index completion.

200.description: Stable scan result after Source Version metadata registration.

post.description: Validates, parses and chunks immutable Content Artifact bytes. Replays are idempotent and return persisted Attempt state.

201.description: A new Ingestion Attempt completed and persisted.

200.description: An idempotent replay returned the persisted Attempt or Projection.

400.description: Invalid Source Version, request or media/content policy.

404.description: Source Version or Content Artifact not found.

409.description: Attempt, content or projection consistency conflict.

503.description: Filesystem, parser or database dependency unavailable.

202.description: Durable Workflow Run accepted; completion is not implied.

409.description: Definition version or workflow state conflict.

200.description: Current durable Workflow Run state.
Workflow pause command persisted or replayed.

400.description: Invalid control request or idempotency key.

200.description: Workflow resume command persisted or replayed.

400.description: Invalid control request or idempotency key.

200.description: Workflow cancel command persisted or replayed.

400.description: Invalid control request or idempotency key.

200.description: Human Task submitted once and Workflow resumed.

409.description: Task already resolved, expired or version-conflicted.

post.description: Creates a ready-for-review Proposal and immutable Revision. No Workspace file is modified.

200.description: The same idempotent request was replayed; the existing Proposal is returned.

400.description: Invalid target, hash or required Proposal field.

200.description: Current consistent Proposal, Revision and optional Approval snapshot.

201.description: Decision created. Approved responses atomically include the unique Safe Writeback Workflow dispatch; Rejected responses contain no Workflow fields.

200.description: The exact immutable decision and, for Approved, the same Workflow/Node/River dispatch binding were replayed.

409.description: Proposal is not ready, already decided, or Change Hash mismatched.

post.description: Reads the real target file hash inside the persisted Workspace and verifies Approval, Revision, Change Hash and base hash. It performs no write and issues no write authorization.

200.description: Current preflight checks passed; write_performed is always false.

409.description: Revision, Change Hash or real target base hash conflict; baseline conflict moves Proposal to needs_revision.

503.description: Workspace or Change Control dependency unavailable.

200.description: Exact idempotent replay.
Stable activity-ordered page.
Conversation resource.

202.description: Question accepted; poll status_url or subscribe to events.

200.description: Exact idempotent replay.
Stable ordinal-ordered Turn page.
Authoritative Answer and Workflow projection.
Exact idempotent replay.
SSE stream. Each data field is a ServerEventEnvelope; heartbeat comments carry no data.

post.description: Runs an Active-only bounded Keyword, Semantic or Hybrid retrieval query. This is a read-only query and does not require Idempotency-Key.

200.description: A stable page from the current top-100 Search window, including explicit degraded capabilities.

400.description: Invalid JSON, query, filter, mode, limit or cursor.

404.description: The Workspace has no Active Search Index.

409.description: The cursor is stale or a persisted Search/Evidence binding is inconsistent.

500.description: An unexpected internal Search failure occurred.

503.description: Semantic capability or a required Search dependency is unavailable.

200.description: Immutable Source Version metadata for an Evidence provenance.

400.description: Invalid Workspace or Source Version identity.

404.description: The Source Version is absent or does not belong to this Workspace.

409.description: The immutable Source Version/Artifact binding is inconsistent.

500.description: An unexpected internal Evidence Reference failure occurred.

get.description: Reads a bounded excerpt from the immutable Content Artifact after verifying Workspace, Source Version, Projection and Span bindings.

200.description: An immutable Source Span and at most 4 KiB of verified UTF-8 excerpt.

400.description: Invalid Workspace, Source Version or Span identity.

404.description: The Source Version/Span is absent or not bound inside this Workspace.

409.description: The immutable Artifact, Projection, Span or excerpt hash is inconsistent.

500.description: An unexpected internal Evidence Reference failure occurred.

503.description: Evidence Reference storage or managed Artifact reading is unavailable.

ETag.description: Weak resource projection tag. Answer tags bind both Answer and Workflow versions.

BadRequest.description: Invalid strict JSON, identifier, cursor or option.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: JSON command body did not use application/json.

NotFound.description: Resource absent or outside the supplied Workspace; both are indistinguishable.

Conflict.description: Idempotency, lifecycle, active workflow or event cursor conflict.

content_artifact_created.description: True when this scan published the managed immutable bytes; false when an identical artifact was reused.

graph.description: Deprecated compatibility field; must match the server-registered canonical graph.

target_path.description: Workspace-relative POSIX path; absolute paths, backslashes and traversal are rejected.

ApprovalDecisionResponse.description: Approved decisions include workflow_run_id, workflow_status_url and dispatch_status. Rejected decisions omit all three fields.

SearchCursor.description: Opaque process-lifetime HMAC cursor bound to the canonical request, Active Index and complete top-100 result fingerprint. Clients restart from the first page after an invalid or stale cursor.

query.description: After trimming leading and trailing whitespace, the query must be non-empty, valid UTF-8, contain no NUL code point, and use at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes. maxLength remains a conservative code-point bound; x-max-utf8-bytes is the authoritative byte limit.

VectorDistance.description: The raw distance produced by the Active Embedding Version's persisted pgvector distance operator; lower ranks first and values are not comparable across models.

PageCursor.description: Opaque versioned base64url cursor bound to the resource and sort order.

question.description: Non-blank UTF-8 text, at most 8192 bytes, with no NUL.
